75
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 8, 2006/Phalguna 17, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
ASEAN-India Summit
*241. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what follow-up action Government
have taken so far after the Fourth ASEAN-
India Summit held in December 2005 which
was attended by the Prime Minister of
India;
(b) whether there was any headway
towards opening of more gateways along
the Indo-Myanmar Border to facilitate
development of the North Eatsern Region;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if reply to part (b) above be in the
negative, the reasons therefor?
Hoax call regarding bomb in
Parliament House
†*242. SHRI VASANT CHAVAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) whether an E-mail was received with
regard to the rumour of a bomb planted in
the Parliament House;
(b) if so, whether accused have been
caught; and
(c) the details of the terrorist
organization working behind the said
rumour/E-mail?
 Ratio of manufacturing sector to GDP
†*243. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the last
decade contribution of the manufacturing
sector to the Gross Domestic Product
remained between 15 per cent to 17 per
cent;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that during
the current decade Government have fixed
a target to increase its contribution; and

76
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Guidelines for FDI in retail trade
†*244. SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have issued guidelines for FDI in retail trade
of 'single brand' products;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the companies which have filed their
applications with the Department of
Industrial Policy and Promotions (DIPP)
for prior approval with the names of
'brands'?
MIG-21 crashes
*245. SHRI PRASANTA CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of accidents/crashes met
by MIG-21 during the period 1999-2005,
year-wise; and
(b) the reasons for such accidents/
crashes?
Non-deposit of employer's EPF share
by contractors
*246. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of contractors do not deposit regularly/
properly the employer's share of EPF
contribution and as a result thereof, workers
are unable to get the benefits of their EPF
contributions;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the number of defaulting contractors and
the number of the affected contract workers
in each State; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
Uniform labour policy
†*247. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
 Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
needs a uniform labour policy acceptable
to all;
(b) if so, Governments' reaction thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that different
labour laws have been implemented by
different departments in the name of labour
reforms; and
(d) if so, the details of such departments
indicating the variation in labour laws
applicable therein?
Unorganised Sector Worker's Social
Security Scheme
*248. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of the
Unorganised Sector Worker's Social
Security Scheme launched by his Ministry
during 2004;
(b) how many members have been
enrolled under the said scheme and the
amount of contributions realized; and

77
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) how much expenditure has been
incurred so far for implementing the said
scheme?
Abolition of child Labour
*249. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to abolish child labour in the
country within a time bound programme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have received
any financial aid from the World Bank,
International Labour Organisation and
UNICEF for abolition of child labour; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and to what
extent these financial aids are found to be
helpful in achieving the goal?
Allocation for Indira Awaas Yojana
*250. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
SHRIMATI VANGA
GEETHA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have increased
allocation under Indira Awaas Yojana to
Rs. 2750 crores

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the March 8, 2006/Phalguna 17, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
Tax holiday for EOUs
1626. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Export Oriented Unit
(EOU) have demanded that they also be
given a Tax holiday on par with SEZ's;
(b) if so, the specific demand in this
regard;
(c) Government's reaction thereto;
(d) what other steps Government would
take to create adequate incentives for EOU's
to meet their challenges in the international
market; and
(e) the steps proposed to increase the
incentives being given to the Export
Oriented Units in the country?
FTA with China
1627. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
China are going to have a Free Trade
Agreement ;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the apex
body of the Indian exporters FECO
supported the move with a rider to have a
negative list which should include items like
textiles, auto components, leather, etc.; and
(c) the progress of talks on the FTA
with China?
Grant of patents to inventions
1628. SHRI SANJAY RAUT : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of inventions, which have
been granted Patents by Government in
the field of energy and automobile sectors
since last two years; and
(b) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken for using such inventions for the all-
round development in energy and
automobile sectors in the country?
Priority to N.E. region for trade
1629. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have accorded

369
priority to making its North Eastern region
as an important Economic link with the
BIMSTEC members, in anticipation that
the North Eastern States could become
India's link to BIMSTEC and to ASIAN
countries; and
(b) if so, whether Government have
formulated any strategy in this regard with
details thereof?
FDI in retail sector
1630. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have allowed
FDI in retail sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the various sectors/items in which
the FDI has been allowed; and
(d) the various steps taken to save the
small traders?
Subsidy on fuel for fishing
 vessels
1631. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Marine Products Export
Development Authority (MPEDA) has a
scheme to subsidise the prices of fuel oil
used in fishing vessels in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what was the extent of this subsidy
in 2003-04 given by MPEDA;
(d) whether there is proposal to expand
this scheme by MPEDA; and
(e) the steps proposed by MPEDA to
expand and simplify this scheme to
subsidise diesel and other fuel?
India's share in World Farm
Trade
1632. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN :
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
double India's share in World Farm Trade;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the amount of agro-exports of various
products for the last three years, year-wise,
item-wise and category-wise;
(c) whether there are any steps to index
the export potential of different agricultural
crops;
(d) if so, the details of such index
prepared for various crops as on date;
and
(e) the steps taken/to be taken as a
perspective of agricultural export
promotion policy to achieve the above
goal ?
Proposals under  IIUS
1633. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of the proposals
submitted by various State Governments
under Industrial Infrastructure
Upgradation Scheme, location-wise, State-
wise;
(b) the number of proposals cleared so
far State-wise, location-wise;
(c) the reasons for the delay in clearing
the remaining proposals; and
(d) the time by when these proposals
are likely to be cleared?

370
Financial assistance for cluster
development
1634. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY : Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Karnataka Government has
sought financial assistance for 5 projects
on cluster development;
(b) if so, which are the projects on
cluster development awaiting approval of
Government; and
(c) what is the present status of the
above proposal?
Assistance to leather industry for
water treatment facilities
1635. SHRI C. PERUMAL : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether leather industry has
requested for Rs. 100 crore assistance to
set up water treatment facilities at the
effluent treatment plants for small tanners;
(b) if so, whether any decision has been
